confidence_notes: Food, cappuccino, and beer use Brighton's May 2026 Numbeo estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use their local price relationship to beer, checked against 2026 Brighton menu and guide ranges. Expedia's annual hotel trend is citywide rather than star-specific, and hostel sources mainly show starting rates, so accommodation anchors are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; Brighton-specific price and accommodation results informed the estimates.
